# Hack & Develop With Ai

> Unlimited AI API gateway: one key for 24 AI models with no token quota and no request cap. Plans from $40 a month, paid by UPI, card or QR code.

## What this site offers
- Unlimited tokens and unlimited requests on every subscription plan.
- 24 models: Claude Haiku 5.5, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6.1 Terra, Gemini 3.8 Flash, GLM 5.3, GLM 5.3 Flash, MiniMax M3.1 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Qwen3.8-Max, Qwen4-Max, Qwen 3.8 Flash Next, Mimo V2.6 Flash, GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Gemini 4 Argon, Kimi K3, Kimi K3.1, GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Fable 5.1.
- OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions and /v1/responses; Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages.
- Base URL: https://freeai.hackdevelopwithai.com/v1
- Clients: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, OpenCode, Kilo Code.

## Plans
- Pro: $40/month (monthly only), 4 parallel sessions, 60 requests/min, 13 models (4 base + 9 Pro set).
- Max: $55/month (monthly only), 8 parallel sessions, 120 requests/min, 20 models.
- Ultra: $20/day or $100/month, 14 parallel sessions, 240 requests/min, all 24 models.
- Token Plans: $25/$100/$600 base and $50/$185/$1200 frontier, 30 days. Pay-per-use: 20% of official price, balance never expires.
